outcome: Composite outcome of neonatal sepsis, mechanical ventilation ≥24 hours, and perinatal death
cohort: 721 neonates delivered from mothers with ROM between 34(0/7) and 36(6/7) weeks' gestation
finding: The administration of latency antibiotics to women admitted with ROM between 34(0/7) and 36(6/7) weeks' gestation did not significantly decrease the rate of neonatal sepsis.
